data.name: Pedal Me Bicycle Deliveries
data.abstract: A dataset of weekly bicycle package deliveries by Pedal Me in London during 2020 and 2021. Nodes in the graph represent geographical units and edges are proximity based mutual adjacency relationships.

intro_paper.title: PyTorch Geometric Temporal: Spatiotemporal Signal Processing with Neural Machine Learning Models
intro_paper.authors: Benedek Rozemberczki, P. Scherer, Yixuan He, G. Panagopoulos, M. Astefanoaei, Olivér Kiss, Ferenc Béres, Nicolas Collignon, Rik Sarkar
intro_paper.venue: International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management

additional_info.summary: A dataset about the number of weekly bicycle package deliveries by Pedal Me in London during 2020 and 2021. Nodes in the graph represent geographical units and edges are proximity based mutual adjacency relationships.
